title: Taking Charley Johnson's Newark job; first dope fiend
summary: Charley Johnson recommends Wooding for his Newark job and shows him a drug user nodding off at the piano.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: So what made you go to Newark, New Jersey? How did --
Well I was brought to New York later on. I was brought to New York with by old man Baron.
Yeah, I said what made you go from
Atlantic City to Newark, New Jersey?

Oh, Newark. I didn't get that. Well, the reason that I went to Newark was that Charley Johnson had been there. And he worked at someplace there. And, when he was leaving to come back to Atlantic City, and they wanted somebody else there. So he was hoping that I could make it. So he had me to come up there and take his job. See?
And, but the funny thing, the first time I'd ever seen a dope fiend, too. I didn't know nothing about the dope fiends or nothing like that.

But Charley said to me one night, he said, 'You see this fellow coming in here? Watch him. He'll lean right on this piano and go sound to sleep.' And he told me and sure enough, he walked right in there, went sound to sleep and his knees bent, he went on down, instead of holding on the piano, and he come on up and sat there. And after a little while, he said, 'Hello, Charley', and turned around and walked on out.
Well, this was all new to me, see. You know, I'm still a kid in a way of speaking. Of course, I'm not of age yet, see. So now we're getting ready to go to war.
